## Details

<a id="title_logo_boulder"></a>
### [`title_logo_boulder`](../../../../src/data/title_logo.asm#L6) `$66E8-$66F7`

*data*

Top of the word BOULDER of the title logo in text characters. The title copies these 16 bytes to columns 0-15 of map row 2.

- **Read by:** [`draw_title_screen`](../title/draw_title_screen.md#draw_title_screen)

<a id="title_logo_boulder_rows"></a>
### [`title_logo_boulder_rows`](../../../../src/data/title_logo.asm#L10) `$66F8-$67E7`

*data*

Rows 3-8 of the BOULDER logo, 40 characters each, copied to the map at $0878. Character $03 is a block, $08-$0a are edges.

- **Read by:** [`draw_title_screen`](../title/draw_title_screen.md#draw_title_screen)

<a id="title_logo_dash"></a>
### [`title_logo_dash`](../../../../src/data/title_logo.asm#L42) `$67E8-$67F7`

*data*

Top of the word DASH of the title logo. The title copies these 16 bytes to columns 0-15 of map row 10.

- **Read by:** [`draw_title_screen`](../title/draw_title_screen.md#draw_title_screen)

<a id="title_logo_dash_rows"></a>
### [`title_logo_dash_rows`](../../../../src/data/title_logo.asm#L46) `$67F8-$68E7`

*data*

Rows 11-16 of the DASH logo, 40 characters each, copied to the map at $09b8. Characters $1d-$1f after the word are a TM sign.

- **Read by:** [`draw_title_screen`](../title/draw_title_screen.md#draw_title_screen)
